translation:
Agalod

Having taken diksha (initiation) from Jivanji Maharaj, Krishnadas went to Agalod. There he stayed at the home of the devotee Dhana Mangala Shitala, and Krishnadas made his own home there. Today at that place there is only a ruined, abandoned plot resembling an old tulsi-kyaro. From there his descendants came and settled in Sardarpur; therefore Agalod is a punya sthali (a place of religious merit).
